items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: did that in New York with Shirley Clay, and we worked together at the -- at this dancing school down there.

ctx.x: We used to practice that. Shaking our head -- moving our head up and down when we played trumpet, back in the '20's, did that in New York with Shirley Clay, and we worked together at the -- at this dancing school down there. With Bingie Madison's band, I played down there. With Shirley Clay, we used to -- why we practiced shaking our head, playing jazz courses, to get that sound like Louie did.
What about playing, for instance, with the valves half way down? Was when you were first taught by Mr. Davis?
